IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. RANDOMSEQ. DATA DIVISION. WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 01 R1 PIC V9(18) COMP-3. 01 R2 PIC V9(18) COMP-3. 01 R3 PIC V9(18) COMP-3. 01 R4 PIC V9(18) COMP-3. PROCEDURE DIVISION. MOVE FUNCTION RANDOM(7) TO R1. MOVE FUNCTION RANDOM TO R2. MOVE FUNCTION RANDOM TO R3. MOVE FUNCTION RANDOM(7) TO R4. IF R1 = R4 AND R1 > 0 AND R1 < 1 AND R2 > 0 AND R2 < 1 AND R3 > 0 AND R3 < 1 AND R1 <> R2 AND R2 <> R3 DISPLAY 'SEQ' ELSE DISPLAY 'BAD' END-IF. STOP RUN.
